inputs: exposed dev only; locked test and gold never enter predictor or call gate

arms.M0: Frozen Stage 5 baseline predictions, no model calls
arms.M1: M0 plus HCX-003 QueryInterpreter expansion; original query and candidates protected
arms.M2: M0 plus HCX-007 on identical QueryInterpreter packets
arms.M3: HCX-003 versus HCX-007 EvidenceJudge on identical candidate IDs, conditions and evidence
arms.M4: Jev versus HCX-003/007 DecisionClassifier on identical fixed-choice packets
arms.M5: Deferred; reranker and embeddings require separate single-effect need and budget

control.document_comparison: title_path_depth versus same base plus selected metadata
control.metadata_limitation: Stage 6 probe adds one metadata reference per candidate; insufficiency does not prove that full official metadata lacks evidence

input_features: unresolved expressions from rule/dictionary pass with source spans
unknown or conflicting official condition checks among candidates
candidate disagreement between original and metadata channels
conditional_gate_proposal.comparison: same exposed dev 36 cases for always and conditional; excluded cases remain in denominator
conditional_gate_proposal.scope_note: Current 9-case role packets cannot establish a 36-case call policy

measurement.repeat_subset: initial 7 jobs repeated once after the first 44 role jobs
measurement.repair_budget: at most 1 repair per job, included in whole-experiment limits
measurement.uncertainty: paired case-level bootstrap of metric differences, 10000 resamples, seed 20261005; aggregate repeats within each case, report paired n and wins/ties/losses
measurement.small_n_warning: No population superiority claim from smoke or 9 exposed cases
measurement.semantic_review: human review pending; schema, source quotation and provider confidence are not semantic labels
measurement.retrieval_scorer: existing a_eval_score after predictions, unchanged draft labels

necessary_conditions: actual paired improvement in intended failure type
no original candidate loss or explicit condition distortion
reviewed semantic labels and reported failures
measured latency and cost acceptable for agreed operating target
adoption.tie_break: fewer calls, smaller evidence scope, lower measured cost, simpler flow
adoption.next_stage: Stage 8 integration only after explicit adoption or limited integration-test scope
